text: A “Bound” chip (Lucide link icon) in the header; the banner names the collection and field and offers Unbind — but nothing below it is read-only. Typing here or on the canvas is accepted and silently reverted on the next content refresh. Two more things this state does not say: a binding to a DRAFT record publishes that draft's text, and publishing a record does not refresh the canvas.

AI proposes a diff for anything you ask it to change, except two writes that land straight away: alt text for a new image, and “Write with AI” on a page's SEO title. Each Apply lands as one undo step; a multi-step draft applies one step at a time.

The schema, not the data. Deleting a field hides its values rather than deleting them — every record keeps them until it is next saved — and silently blanks every element bound to it. Nothing can count those.

Tree fetching. The toolbar stays for position, not for use — its controls talk to the panel that has not mounted. The footer keeps counting: it renders the literal “0 layers” for the whole load, which is not a count of anything.

Row: checkbox · drag grip · icon (home ⌂ / external ↗ only) · name · in-folder tag while searching · dirty ● · ⋯ overflow — ⋯ or right-click opens the same menu, and double-clicking the name renames in place. Folders nest one level and reveal rename + delete on hover (delete keeps the pages). They live in this browser's localStorage only (pg-folders-v1-<siteId>), so a teammate or a second device sees a flat list.

Restore from the Saves list always confirms and always saves the current state as a version first — if that save fails the restore is abandoned. It replaces pages, styles, every project setting (brand tokens, SEO, analytics, custom code) and the element→content bindings; the content records themselves, media and saved components are untouched. Restoring from the activity list or the scrubber does neither.

28h dense rows. At depth 5 the name gets 96px: 280 − 92 indent − 12 chevron − 12 icon − 4×8 gaps − 30 for the two toggles − 6 right pad. The long row here is the stress case. A row shows a custom name, else the element’s own first 32 characters, else the type label.
Empty states: 🎨 'No color tokens yet — Add tokens in the Design tab' (the code still says “Design tab”; the rail calls it Brand) · 'No tokens found'

RETIRED 2026-09-02 — no producer. Disabled, never hidden: a “Soon” badge beside the label, no drag, and a tooltip carrying the element's own description. The 45% dim was never built. (The card board described a drop rejection here — that is invalid-drop, a different state.)

Hidden is not deleted. 45% opacity, keeps its place in the tree. Dimming opens no undo step, so ⌘Z undoes your previous edit instead and the dim stays on — and it is stored in this browser only, so a collaborator does not see it.

Session-only activity feed, derived from the undo stack: what changed and when, in this tab. The project load resets the stack, so it is empty after every reload — not persisted, not per user. The stack holds the last 100 steps; older ones drop with nothing said, so a named version is the only thing GUARANTEED to survive a long session.

Two independent panes. Left is the approved snapshot, right is the site as it is now. Each pane is a sandboxed frame and nothing syncs them — the labels carry the asymmetry, not colour. (A third mode, List, shows the same comparison as rows.)
Deploy state unknown. The button should be disabled here; the shipping panel leaves it live (PublishTab.tsx:698 does not gate on loading).

Publishing is not wired in this build (NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_PUBLISH off), and this is what PublishTab renders then — noPublishPath at PublishTab.tsx:324. In a production bundle without that flag it is the panel EVERY user sees, and its “Connect Vercel” CTA cannot unblock anything. The copy drawn here is the shipped copy, verbatim. The real missing-connection state is board 893:4518.
expect: Publishing is not wired in this build
